# Triangulate: store copy (Loopwork Games)

## Title
Triangulate

## Short description (145 chars)
Guess where on Earth a map fragment is from, starting with just its coastline. Lock in early for more points and outlast 19 bots across 7 rounds.

## Long description
Triangulate is a geography battle royale played from map shapes alone. There's no street view, just a fragment of a real map and a world map to drop your pin on.

Every round reveals the fragment in four stages:
- Coastline (×2.0 points)
- Rivers (×1.6)
- Roads & rail (×1.3)
- Place names (×1.0)

Lock in early on just a coastline for big points, or wait for more clues and play it safe. The closer your pin, the more you score.

Each match puts you against 19 computer-controlled rivals over 7 rounds. After rounds 2 to 6, the bottom 25% are eliminated. Survive to the final round and finish with the most points to win.

Features:
- 300+ locations: lakes, straits, islands, river deltas and cities on every continent, getting harder each round
- Daily Solo: the same 5 locations for everyone each day, plus a shareable emoji result grid
- XP, levels and daily streaks
- Three visual styles: Night, Atlas and Arcade
- Plays in seconds on desktop and mobile, with no account and no download

Matches are against computer-controlled players (marked 🤖), so a game is always ready to start.

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain).

## Controls
- Mouse: drag to pan the world map, scroll wheel to zoom, and click to drop a pin. Click LOCK IN, or press Space or Enter, to lock your guess.
- Touch: drag to pan, pinch to zoom, and tap to drop a pin. Tap LOCK IN to lock your guess.
- Tap the standings button to show or hide the live leaderboard on small screens.
